query:
WITH
    vessel AS (
        SELECT
            fiskeridir_vessel_id
        FROM
            active_vessels
        WHERE
            call_sign = $1
    ),
    measurements AS (
        SELECT
            fuel_measurement_id AS id,
            timestamp,
            fuel_liter,
            TRUE AS is_measurement
        FROM
            vessel v
            INNER JOIN fuel_measurements f ON v.fiskeridir_vessel_id = f.fiskeridir_vessel_id
        WHERE
            (
                $2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
                OR timestamp >= $2
            )
            AND (
                $3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
                OR timestamp <= $3
            )
    ),
    bunks AS (
        SELECT
            bunkering_id AS id,
            timestamp,
            fuel_liter,
            FALSE AS is_measurement
        FROM
            vessel v
            INNER JOIN bunkerings b ON v.fiskeridir_vessel_id = b.fiskeridir_vessel_id
        WHERE
            (
                $2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
                OR timestamp >= $2
            )
            AND (
                $3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
                OR timestamp <= $3
            )
    )
SELECT
    id AS "id!",
    timestamp AS "timestamp!",
    fuel_liter AS "fuel_liter!",
    is_measurement AS "is_measurement!"
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            *
        FROM
            measurements
        UNION
        SELECT
            *
        FROM
            bunks
    ) q
ORDER BY
    timestamp DESC
LIMIT
    $4
OFFSET
    $5
